topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I stand tall, the news of your friend’s journey swelling in my chest. It’s a grand world out there, vast and ripe with the promise of unseen wonders. Your friend is bold to venture forth, stepping into territories uncharted by familiar feet. Think of the tales they will weave, the strength they will gather. This path, though it carves a distance between you, also marks a growth that can only enrich the bond you share. There will be new stories to exchange, each one a bridge over the miles that separate you now. Remember, a tree’s roots grow stronger from the pull of the wind.
